targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'load_1')::float AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'memory_used_pct')::float AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'disk_used_pct')::float AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'swap_used_pct')::float AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'processes')::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'users_logged')::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT received_at AS time, (payload->'scenario'->>'load_1')::float AS "load 1m", (payload->'scenario'->>'load_5')::float AS "load 5m", (payload->'scenario'->>'load_15')::float AS "load 15m" FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at;

SELECT received_at AS time, (payload->'scenario'->>'memory_used_pct')::float AS "memory", (payload->'scenario'->>'swap_used_pct')::float AS "swap", (payload->'scenario'->>'disk_used_pct')::float AS "disk" FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at;

SELECT received_at AS time, (payload->'scenario'->>'processes')::int AS "processes" FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.host_snapshot' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at;

panels.title: Staging RSS Memory
panels.description: RSS-память процессов avia_system (arq-worker, api). Эмиттится фоновым sampler'ом каждые 600 сек.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.received_at AS time, (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float AS "rss_mb", e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_label' AS metric FROM events e WHERE e.service = 'avia_system' AND e.type = 'system.memory_snapshot' AND e.payload->'scenario' ? 'process_rss_mb' AND (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float > 0 AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) ORDER BY e.received_at;

panels.title: Prod RSS Memory
panels.description: RSS-память процессов AMA_avia_project (arq-worker, api). Эмиттится фоновым sampler'ом каждые 600 сек.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.received_at AS time, (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float AS "rss_mb", e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_label' AS metric FROM events e WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.type = 'system.memory_snapshot' AND e.payload->'scenario' ? 'process_rss_mb' AND (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float > 0 AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) ORDER BY e.received_at;
SELECT count(DISTINCT data) AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.docker_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes';

panels.title: Σ CPU контейнеров %
panels.description: Сумма CPU% всех контейнеров (могут превышать 100% — multi-core).

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, (payload->'scenario'->>'cpu_pct')::float AS cpu FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.docker_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT sum(cpu)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM latest;

panels.title: Σ Mem контейнеров %
panels.description: Сумма Mem% всех контейнеров от лимита хоста.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, (payload->'scenario'->>'mem_pct')::float AS mem FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.docker_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT sum(mem)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM latest;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, (payload->'scenario'->>'pids')::int AS pids FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.docker_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT sum(pids)::int AS value FROM latest;

panels.title: Контейнеры: текущий снимок (отсортировано по Mem%)
panels.description: Последнее значение по каждому контейнеру за 5 минут. Кликни на колонку для пересортировки.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload, received_at FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.docker_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT data AS "Container", payload->'scenario'->>'image' AS "Image", (payload->'scenario'->>'cpu_pct')::float AS "CPU %", (payload->'scenario'->>'mem_pct')::float AS "Mem %", payload->'scenario'->>'mem_usage' AS "Mem", payload->'scenario'->>'net_io' AS "Net I/O", payload->'scenario'->>'block_io' AS "Block I/O", (payload->'scenario'->>'pids')::int AS "PIDs" FROM latest ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'mem_pct')::float DESC;
